conventions.coverage: Every source-discovered physical field and every proposed local/desktop contract field is named exactly once under its owning entity; no business rows are embedded.
conventions.nullability: true/false comes from source declarations where statically visible; null explicitly requires runtime metadata introspection and is not treated as an unknown or omitted field.
conventions.sensitivity: restricted covers credentials, national identifiers, banking, biometrics and arbitrary personal payloads; confidential covers personal/contact/document data; internal covers technical metadata.
conventions.references: foreign-key comes from migrations; logical comes from models or explicit contracts; snapshot denotes print/delivery evidence rather than a live master-data reference.
conventions.values: The catalogs contain field metadata only. Screen example values and all real personal data are intentionally excluded.
